### [371] [Visibility Without Guidance: Measuring the Actionability of Public Crisis Communication in Lebanon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14714)
*Mohamed Soufan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对2026年4-5月黎巴嫩冲突升级期间9家机构发布的182条公共沟通信息进行系统性可行动性审计，发现平均可行动性得分仅为1.98/5，其中89.6%的信息缺少获取渠道或联系方式，表明机构危机沟通多为信息性而非指导性，存在显著的行动指导缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共危机沟通的价值在于促使公众采取保护行动，而当前危机沟通是否存在行动指导不足的问题尚待系统评估。本研究旨在检验黎巴嫩冲突升级期间机构危机沟通是否达到了提供可行动指导的标准。

Method: 对182条公共沟通信息进行系统性可行动性审计，每条信息在五个二分维度（具体地点、明确指令、获取渠道/联系方式、时间/日期参考、目标群体识别）上编码，计算0-5分的可行动性得分（五个维度的算术和），并机械验证所有项目的一致性。

Result: 平均可行动性得分1.98/5，46.7%的项目得分为0或1；89.6%的项目缺少获取渠道或联系方式；联合国人道主义机构平均得分3.10，高于国家及部委来源的1.35，应急响应机构居中；信息型报道多于操作型指导。

Conclusion: 该时期机构危机沟通多为信息性而非指导性，与促使公众采取保护行动的标准存在显著差距。研究提供了可复制的审计框架，用于评估类似情境下的危机沟通充分性。

Abstract: Public crisis communication is most valuable when it enables protective action: when it tells affected populations not only what is happening, but where, what to do, how to access help, and whom the guidance applies to. This study examines whether institutional crisis communication in Lebanon during an active conflict escalation met that standard. It presents a systematic actionability audit of 182 public-facing communication items issued by nine Lebanese state institutions, emergency responders, and United Nations humanitarian agencies between April 1 and May 7, 2026.
  Each item was coded on five binary dimensions: specific location, clear instruction, access channel or contact, time or date reference, and target group identification. An actionability score between 0 and 5 was calculated as the arithmetic sum of the five dimensions, with score consistency mechanically verified across all items.
  Findings indicate a substantial gap between communicative output and actionable guidance. The mean actionability score was 1.98 out of 5, with 46.7% of items scoring 0 or 1. Access channel or contact information was absent from 89.6% of items. UN humanitarian agencies produced a mean score of 3.10, compared with 1.35 for state and ministry sources, while emergency responders occupied an intermediate position. Communication type analysis shows that informational reporting was more prevalent than operational guidance. The findings suggest that institutional communication during this period was often informative rather than directive, and offer a replicable audit framework for assessing crisis communication adequacy in comparable contexts.

</details>


### [372] [Gender Differences in AI Literacy Workshop Outcomes and Deepfake Engagement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14718)
*Jake Renzella,Christian Bergh,Natasha Banks,Alexandra Vassar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对199名澳大利亚中学生（7、8、10年级）的AI素养工作坊前后测研究，发现男生在STEM职业兴趣上普遍更高，女生更倾向使用AI辅助学习；男生参与深度伪造内容的创作/分享行为显著更高。单日工作坊虽能提升双方AI知识，但女生在概念理解、自信心及STEM职业兴趣方面改善更显著，部分缩小了性别差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着K-12阶段人工智能素养教育的推广，性别如何影响学生对AI的基线认知、工具使用行为及干预措施的响应尚不明确。理解这些差异对于设计公平的AI课程至关重要。

Method: 对来自两所公立混合学校的199名澳大利亚中学生（7、8、10年级）开展单日AI素养工作坊，采用前后测设计（前测n=199，后测n=136），运用统计回归方法控制年级和学校变量，分析性别在AI素养、安全意识及STEM职业志向上的差异。

Result: 工作坊前，男生在AI、计算机科学和工程三个领域的STEM职业兴趣显著更高；女生更倾向于使用AI完成学业任务并向AI工具寻求建议。男生创建或分享深度伪造内容的比例显著更高。工作坊后，两性AI知识均提升，但女生表现出更丰富的增长：更广的概念理解、更高的自信心，以及在AI和计算机科学职业兴趣上的显著提升，部分缩小了STEM性别差距。

Conclusion: 需要设计具有性别响应性的AI课程，尤其应针对男生加强深度伪造安全教育；即使是单日工作坊也能部分缩小STEM职业志向和AI自信上的性别差距。

Abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) literacy initiatives expand in K-12 settings, understanding how gender shapes student baseline perceptions, tool-use, and responsiveness to interventions is essential for equitable curriculum design. This study examines gender differences in AI literacy, safety awareness, and STEM career aspirations among Australian secondary students (Years 7, 8, and 10; N(pre) = 199, n(post) = 136) from two co-educational government schools who participated in a one-day AI literacy workshop. Using statistical regression methods controlling for year level and school, we found that pre-workshop, male students reported significantly higher STEM career interest across all three domains (AI, computer science, and engineering), while female students were significantly more likely to use AI for schoolwork and to seek advice from AI tools. Gender-differentiated patterns also emerged in deepfake behaviours: males were significantly more likely to have created or shared deepfake content. Both genders improved in AI knowledge post-intervention, yet females showed a richer profile of gains: wider conceptual understanding, greater confidence, and meaningful increases in AI and CS career interest that partially narrowed the gender STEM gap. These findings highlight the need for gender-responsive AI curricula, particularly deepfake safety education for male students, and demonstrate that even single-day workshops can narrow gender gaps in STEM aspirations and AI confidence.

</details>


### [373] [Grand Challenges for the Convergence of Computational and Citizen Science Research Workshop Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14719)
*Lucy Fortson,Lea Shanley,Tanya Berger-Wolf,Kevin Crowston,Corey Jackson,Saiph Savage,Haley Griffin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本报告基于2025年4月CCC愿景研讨会，提出计算科学与公民科学融合的研究议程，探讨人机协作解决重大科学问题，并强调公民科学的经济与国家价值及其对新型研究基础设施的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过融合计算科学与公民科学，利用人机协作解决全球最紧迫的科学问题，同时发挥公民科学在经济、国家能力延伸和联邦优先事项支持方面的巨大价值。

Method: 于2025年4月8-9日在华盛顿特区举办CCC愿景研讨会，并结合多次前期虚拟输入收集会议，汇聚跨学科专家共同制定研究议程。

Result: 明确了公民科学在志愿者劳动力价值、政府机构能力延伸及联邦优先领域（如灾害管理、公共卫生、水资源、能源、劳动力发展）中的可量化经济和国家级价值；指出了公民科学对安全、隐私、资源适配性和透明性等新型鲁棒研究基础设施的需求。

Conclusion: 报告概述了关键发现、未来研究方向和具体建议，为计算科学与公民科学的融合研究奠定了议程基础。

Abstract: This report is an outcome of a Computing Community Consortium (CCC) visioning workshop on Grand Challenges for the Convergence of Computational and Citizen Science Research conducted on April 8-9, 2025, in Washington, D.C. as well as through several precursor virtual input-gathering sessions. These events brought together experts across relevant disciplines to develop a research agenda that brings to fruition the above vision on how humans and machines may team up to solve some of the world's most pressing scientific problems.
  Citizen science delivers measurable economic and national value. Public participation in scientific research generates millions of dollars in volunteer labor value, extends government agency capacity, and directly supports federal priorities in areas such as disaster management, public health, water, energy, workforce development, and many more. At the same time, 21st-century scientific infrastructure requirements for citizen science (from hardware and cyberinfrastructure to data and computational frameworks) mirror those for computational science more generally. The distributed, collaborative, long-term, and contextual nature of citizen science makes it a demanding real-world use case for a novel robust research infrastructure that accounts for security, privacy, resource adaptability, and transparency. In this report, we outline the key findings, future research directions, and recommendations that emerged from the April 2025 CCC Grand Challenges for the Convergence of Computational and Citizen Science Research Workshop.

</details>


### [374] ["Stuck in a Spiral": Shame and Guilt as Social Regulators of AI Use in Computing Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14920)
*Kate Hamilton,Irene Hou,Dev Patel,Sheena Nnam,Hena Patel,Stephen MacNeil*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对19名计算机专业学生的访谈研究，探讨羞耻感和内疚感等情绪因素如何影响学生对AI工具的使用。研究发现这些情绪调节学生何时以及如何使AI使用可见化，导致隐藏行为和选择性披露。学生自我羞耻、批评同伴甚至教师使用AI，羞耻与内疚常与持续使用AI共存，形成代理感降低和道德紧张的循环，而非促进行为改变。学生描述AI使用与自身能力型、勤奋型或道德型身份认同之间的冲突，并使用成瘾隐喻来描述体验。研究强调需关注AI使用的社会情感方面，并讨论促进健康公开讨论和支持负责任AI使用的课堂实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注AI使用的采纳模式和社会规范，但对羞耻感、内疚感等情绪因素如何影响学生使用AI工具的理解不足，本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用访谈研究方法，对19名计算机专业学生进行半结构化访谈，从羞耻感和内疚感的功能主义视角（将情绪视为调节行为的社会信号）分析数据。

Result: 情绪（羞耻和内疚）调节学生AI使用的可见性，引发隐藏行为和选择性披露；学生自我羞耻并批评他人使用AI；羞耻与内疚常与持续使用共存，形成道德紧张和代理感降低的循环；学生描述AI使用与身份认同的冲突，并使用成瘾隐喻。

Conclusion: 需关注AI使用的社会情感方面，AI政策的实施和执行方式可能影响学生的情绪体验；建议采用促进健康、公开讨论的课堂实践，以支持负责任的AI使用。

Abstract: While prior work has examined patterns of adoption and social norms around AI use, less is known about how emotional factors, such as shame and guilt, shape students use of AI tools. We present an interview study with 19 computing students through a functionalist perspective of shame and guilt, which interprets emotions as social signals that regulate behavior. Our findings show that these emotions regulate when and how students make their use visible, as they engage in hiding behaviors and selective disclosure. Students described shaming themselves, their peers, and even faculty for using AI. Shame and guilt often coexist with continued AI use, creating cycles of reduced agency and moral tension rather than promoting behavior change. Students described feeling tensions between their AI use and their identities as competent, hardworking, or ethical computing students. Students also used language and metaphors of addiction to describe their experiences. These results highlight the need to consider the socio-emotional aspects of AI use, which may be influenced by how AI policies are implemented and enforced. We discuss classroom practices that can foster healthy, open discussion and support responsible AI use.

</details>


### [375] [LearnOpt: Recovering the Latent Cognitive Structure of Standardized Examinations via Knowledge Graphs and Constrained Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15349)
*Joy Bose,Om Thomas*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出LearnOpt，从历史考题中恢复潜在认知结构并生成个性化学习计划。应用于NEET和JEE考试，发现潜在技能分布在教学大纲体制内稳定（KL散度0.004-0.032），但在课程改革时发生显著偏移（KL=0.040, p=0.0005）。考试类型比科目、科目比时间更能塑造认知结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点将标准化考试视为统一的教学大纲覆盖问题，但论文认为应将其理解为具有稳定潜在认知结构的对抗系统，这些结构会系统性偏离官方教学大纲，因此需要新的方法来发现和利用这种结构。

Method: LearnOpt方法包含：1) 用LLM标注考题构建知识图谱；2) 提取五类潜在技能分布；3) 将学习计划制定为背包变体优化问题，结合先决条件感知子图和贝叶斯知识追踪。

Result: 1) NEET潜在技能分布在2016-2021年保持稳定（KL散度0.004-0.032），但2023年课程改革后显著偏移（KL=0.040, p=0.0005）；2) 科目比年份更能预测技能分布；3) JEE Advanced的认知结构以多概念整合为主（80.9%），与NEET（33.3%）差异显著（KL=0.505），远超NEET内部跨科目差异。

Conclusion: 潜在结构并非永久平稳，而是分段稳定的，其偏移可检测且可归因于课程事件。考试类型（如JEE vs NEET）对认知结构的影响大于科目，科目影响大于时间。代码、知识图谱和标注数据集已公开发布。

Abstract: Standardized examinations are typically treated as uniform syllabus coverage problems. We argue they are better understood as adversarial systems with stable latent cognitive structures diverging systematically from official syllabi. We introduce LearnOpt, which recovers this structure from historical question papers and generates personalized, time-bounded study plans. Applied to nine years of NEET questions (2016-2024, n=1,496), LearnOpt builds an exam knowledge graph from LLM-tagged questions, extracts a five-category latent skill distribution, and formulates study planning as a knapsack-variant optimization over prerequisite-aware subgraphs with Bayesian Knowledge Tracing. Central finding: NEET's latent skill distribution is stable within a syllabus regime (consecutive-year KL divergence 0.004-0.032 for 2016-2021, non-significant under permutation testing) but shifts significantly with NCERT's 2023 syllabus rationalization: pooling 2016-2021 (n=1,072) vs 2023-2024 (n=392) gives KL=0.040 (p=0.0005), with Elimination/Negation questions rising from ~20-29% to ~31-35%. Latent structure, while not permanently stationary, is piecewise stable, with shifts detectable and attributable to curricular events. Within either regime, subject predicts skill profile more strongly than year. An optimization evaluation, using one real and two synthetic mastery profiles, shows the skill-weighted objective produces a modest but real reordering of recommended topics over a mastery-conditioned frequency baseline. Applying the pipeline to JEE Advanced reveals a profile dominated by Multi-concept Integration (80.9% vs. 33.3% for NEET), with a JEE-vs-NEET divergence (KL=0.505) exceeding NEET's largest cross-subject divergence: exam tier shapes latent cognitive structure more than subject, which shapes it more than time within a regime. Code, knowledge graph, and annotated dataset are released publicly.

</details>


### [376] [Commons-Governed Artificial Intelligence: A Taxonomy of Collective Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15466)
*Eduardo C. Garrido-Merchán*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"共有治理人工智能"的概念框架，基于奥斯特罗姆的 commons 理论，从资源层（数据、计算、模型、知识与评估、能源）和治理功能两个维度构建分类法，识别出10种制度原型，并将计算能源与可持续性视为首要的 commons 治理问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI治理理论过度依赖市场（私有财产与契约）和国家（监管者自上而下）两种制度框架，而社区自组织的集体 stewardship 实践（如数据信托、联邦学习联盟、公共算力计划、开放权重合作、社区数据主权）虽已大量涌现，却缺乏系统的理论化工具。

Method: 采用二维分类法：第一轴为AI堆栈中作为公共池持有的资源层（数据、计算、模型、知识与评估、能源）；第二轴为基于Ostrom设计原则的治理功能。通过逐层审查已发表证据填充分类法，识别出10个制度原型，并用成熟度矩阵和八项设计原则进行比对分析。

Result: 构建了一个成熟的制度分析框架，定位了10种重复出现的制度原型，揭示了现存实践的制度家族一致性，并将计算能源与可持续性纳入 commons 治理的核心范畴而非外部性。

Conclusion: 研究指出了开放清洗（openwashing）、算力瓶颈、搭便车行为、规模与可持续性之间的张力等关键制约因素，并提出了多中心AI commons 的研究议程。

Abstract: The governance of artificial intelligence is overwhelmingly theorized through two institutional frames. In the market frame, the data, models, and compute that constitute the AI stack are private goods exchanged under property and contract; in the state frame, a regulator imposes rules from above. A third possibility, the collective and self-organized stewardship of AI-relevant resources by the communities that produce and depend on them, remains comparatively under-theorized, even as it proliferates in practice through data trusts and cooperatives, federated learning consortia, public compute initiatives, open-weight model collaborations, and community data sovereignty regimes. This article argues that these arrangements form a coherent institutional family, which we call commons-governed artificial intelligence, and that the analytic vocabulary developed by Elinor Ostrom and her successors for common-pool and knowledge commons is the right backbone for classifying them. We contribute a two-dimensional taxonomy whose first axis is the resource layer of the AI stack held in common, distinguishing data, compute, models, knowledge and evaluation, and energy, and whose second axis is the governance function performed, derived from Ostrom design principles. We populate the taxonomy by examining the published evidence layer by layer, locate ten recurrent institutional archetypes within it, synthesize their positions through a maturity matrix and a comparative reading against the eight design principles, and treat the energy and sustainability of computation as a first-class commons-governance problem rather than an externality. We close with the tensions that constrain the project, openwashing, the compute bottleneck, free-riding, and the tension between scale and sustainability, and with a research agenda for a polycentric AI commons.

</details>


### [377] [The Perils of Agency: How Developers Perceive, Prioritize, and Address Risks in Agentic AI Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15485)
*Hao-Ping Lee,Jessica He,David Piorkowski,Thomas Serban von Davier,Jodi Forlizzi,Sauvik Das*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 一项针对35位行业开发者的实证研究发现，AI智能体系统的自主性、工具使用和真实环境适应性等特性会引发产品风险，但开发者对风险的认知与其产品智能体特性密切相关；他们优先考虑产品/商业风险，忽视下游社会风险，且缺乏成熟的智能体风险控制手段，常常不得不限制智能体功能（如自主性和目标复杂度）来降低风险，从而形成能力与风险控制之间的张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究行业开发者如何感知、优先级排序和应对智能体AI产品中的风险，特别是智能体特性（自主性、工具使用、真实环境适应性）如何引发或加剧产品风险，以及开发者在风险控制方面面临的挑战。

Method: 对35名行业开发者进行定性实证研究，分析他们对智能体AI产品风险的认知、优先级排序和应对策略。

Result: 发现开发者的风险认知与智能体特性（自主性、工具使用、真实环境）紧密相关；开发者优先考虑产品和商业风险，忽视下游社会风险（如岗位替代、用户隐私）；同时缺乏成熟的智能体风险控制手段，只能通过限制智能体功能（如自主性和目标复杂度）来降低风险。

Conclusion: 揭示了智能体AI开发中"能力vs.风险控制"的张力：开发者需要解决智能体能力带来的风险，但目前缺乏在不限制智能体功能的前提下有效控制风险的支持手段。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems act autonomously, use tools, adapt to context, and operate in complex real-world environments. However, these same characteristics can create or exacerbate product risks. We studied how industry developers (n=35) perceive, prioritize, and address the risks in their agentic AI products. We found that developers' perceptions of risk were closely tied to the qualities that made the product agentic, such as autonomy, tool use, and usage in a real-world context. Developers prioritized product and business risks before considering downstream societal risks like job displacement and end-user privacy. This prioritization also impacted developers' ability and motivation to mitigate agentic risks. Finally, developers lacked mature controls for containing agentic risks, often relying on constraining the same characteristics that make agents useful: e.g., autonomy and goal complexity. These findings reveal a capability vs. risk control tension in agentic AI development: developers need to address risks that emerge from agentic capabilities, yet they currently have limited support for doing so without constraining agentic functionality.

</details>


### [378] [Optimising Temporary Accommodation Placement Across London with AI-Powered SaaS in E-Governance Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16652)
*Hankun He,Jordan Richards,Gopalakrishnan Netuveli,Kumar Aniket,Ramya Pachatcharam,Binta Ade-olusile,Nathan Nagaiah,Matthew I Bellgard*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了DOMUS系统——一个为伦敦纽汉姆区量身定制的基于云端的AI辅助决策支持系统，用于临时住宿安置。该系统将政策约束规则、住户记录和私人租赁房源整合到统一工作流中，通过规则过滤与大语言模型辅助搜索相结合，显著缩短了搜索时间、提高了约束遵循度和员工满意度，并被视为可复制的数字公共基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英国地方政府（尤其是伦敦）面临临时住宿需求激增和成本急剧上升的财政与行政压力，现有的手动工作流程效率低下，迫切需要一种既能遵循复杂政策规则、又能保持官员裁量权和可审计性的数字化决策支持工具。

Method: 从零开始构建DOMUS云端AI决策支持系统：整合住户案件记录、政策约束下的可负担性与适宜性规则、以及实时私人租赁房源列表；采用透明规则过滤与大语言模型辅助搜索相结合的方式，标准化卧室需求、可负担阈值、地理偏好和无障碍要求等约束条件；在AI辅助排序和解释前将住户和房产属性编码为政策一致的表示形式；在纽汉姆区的安全环境中进行试点部署并与手动工作流对比评估。

Result: 试点结果表明：搜索时间大幅缩短，关键安置约束的遵循度显著提高，员工满意度高，同时保持了法定合规性和基于角色的可问责性。

Conclusion: DOMUS证明了在地方政府中可扩展、符合伦理的AI部署的可行性，可被视为模块化、云原生的SaaS架构数字公共基础设施，能够推广到英国其他行政区并适用于其他以资源稀缺、规则约束严格和高风险为特征的公共管理任务，为e-governance中AI驱动的公共价值创造提供了参考。

Abstract: Temporary accommodation has become a major fiscal and administrative pressure for English local authorities, particularly in London, where demand and costs have risen sharply. This paper documents the creation and use of DOMUS, a cloud-based, AI-enabled decision-support system built from scratch at the University of East London and customised for the needs of London Borough of Newham to support statutory Temporary accommodation placement. DOMUS integrates household case records, policy-constrained affordability and suitability rules, and live private-rental listings within a single governance-aligned workflow. The system combines transparent, rule-based filtering with large language model-assisted search to standardise the application of bedroom need, affordability thresholds, geographic preferences, and accessibility requirements, while preserving officer discretion and audibility. Household and property attributes are encoded into policy-consistent representations prior to AI-assisted ranking and explanation. A pilot deployment in Newham's secure environment evaluated operational performance relative to manual workflows. Results indicate substantial reductions in search time, improved adherence to key placement constraints, and high staff satisfaction, while maintaining statutory compliance and role-based accountability. Beyond TA, the paper frames DOMUS as replicable digital public infrastructure: a modular, cloud-native Software-as-a-Service architecture that can be deployed across other UK boroughs and adapted to other public administration tasks characterised by scarcity, rule-bound eligibility, and high stakes. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable, ethically governed AI deployment in local government and contribute to debates on AI-enabled public value creation in e-governance.

</details>


### [379] [A Nationwide Benchmark for Wildfire Initial Attack Failure Prediction with Public Environmental Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15529)
*Runyang Xu,Xueqi Cheng,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出WILDFIREIA，首个美国国家级IA失败预测基准，使用火灾发现时的公开数据评估16种模型，发现XGBoost最佳（AUPRC 53.3%），并指出公开数据虽有用但不完备。数据集和代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IA失败预测研究多使用非公开响应数据或局限于区域设置，缺乏基于公开数据的大规模国别级基准，难以评估火灾发现时公开数据对IA失败预测的通用性。

Method: 构建WILDFIREIA基准：对齐38,128起自然火灾事件与FIRMS/VIIRS热探测、gridMET气象、LANDFIRE植被燃料地形、OpenStreetMap道路、WorldPop人口密度等公开数据；固定事件单元、标签规则、时间分割、评价指标和禁止特征列表，排除最终火面积、遏制时间、发现后卫星探测等泄露特征；评估16种代表模型（表格、时序、空间、时空四类）。

Result: XGBoost取得最佳AUPRC为53.3%；FIRMS/VIIRS是最少冗余的数据源；在缺乏动态观测时，燃料是最强的静态预测因子。

Conclusion: 公开发现时数据为IA失败预测提供了有用但不完备的信号，基准和代码开源可支持早期火灾风险评估的可重复研究。

Abstract: Initial attack (IA) is the first wildfire suppression phase, when agencies must quickly decide which fires may escape early control. Existing IA failure prediction studies often use non-public response records or regional settings, so it remains unclear how well public data available at fire discovery time can support IA failure prediction at national scale. We present WILDFIREIA, the first U.S. national-scale benchmark for IA failure prediction from environmental and contextual data available at fire discovery time. WILDFIREIA aligns 38,128 naturally caused FPA-FOD wildfire events with FIRMS/VIIRS thermal detections, gridMET weather and fire-danger variables, LANDFIRE vegetation, fuel, and topography, OpenStreetMap access features, and WorldPop population density. To prevent data leakage, the benchmark fixes the event unit, size-based label rule, chronological split, metrics, and forbidden-feature list, and excludes final fire size, containment timestamps, and post-discovery satellite detections from model inputs. We evaluate 16 representative models across tabular, temporal, spatial, and spatiotemporal families under the same protocol. Results show that public discovery-time data provides useful but incomplete signal for IA failure prediction: XGBoost achieves the best AUPRC of 53.3%; FIRMS/VIIRS is the least redundant source; and fuel is the strongest static predictor when dynamic observations are unavailable. We release preprocessing outputs and model-ready caches to support reproducible research on early wildfire risk assessment: https://github.com/LabRAI/WildfireIA#.

</details>


### [380] [Improving Capstone Team Outcomes through Dynamic Skill Matching and Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15572)
*Brandon Pardi,Garret Castro,Michael Pisman,Avash Adhikari,Santosh Chandrasekhar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种三阶段方法，通过整合学生偏好与项目技能需求，利用大语言模型提取项目技能要求，并采用动态分配算法优化团队组建，相比随机或手动分配，该方法在技能覆盖率和偏好满意度上表现更优，弥补了CATME等工具忽视项目技能匹配的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程与计算机课程中的团队项目因非结构化组队方式导致学生兴趣错位、技能覆盖不足，影响项目成果，需要一种更系统化的团队组建方法。

Method: 三阶段方法：(1)学生填写兴趣与自评技能调查；(2)LLM分析项目描述提取所需技能；(3)动态分配算法迭代优化，同时最大化技能覆盖和偏好对齐，优先满足技能需求未完成的项目。

Result: 初步评估表明，与随机或手动分配相比，该方法组建的团队在技能覆盖率和偏好满意度上更高，且克服了CATME等工具不考虑项目技能匹配的局限。

Conclusion: 该方法为项目式课程提供了一种有效且可定制的策略，有望改善学生动机与学习成果。

Abstract: Team-based projects are a cornerstone of engineering and computing courses, but unstructured team formation often leads to poor project outcomes due to misaligned student interests and inadequate skill coverage. This paper introduces a novel, three-stage methodology for creating effective student teams by integrating student preferences with project skill requirements. In the first stage, students complete a survey to report their project interests and self-assessed skills. Next, a Large Language Model (LLM) analyzes project descriptions to extract the necessary skills for each project's success. Finally, a dynamic assignment algorithm matches students to projects, simultaneously maximizing skill coverage and preference alignment. The algorithm iteratively prioritizes projects with unfulfilled skill needs to optimize team balance. Preliminary evaluations show our approach produces teams with higher skill coverage and better preference satisfaction compared to random or manual assignment approaches. Our approach also overcomes limitations of widely-used tools like CATME Team-Maker, which do not explicitly account for project skill fulfillment. Our findings point toward an effective and customizable strategy for improving student motivation and learning outcomes in project-based courses.

</details>


### [381] [The Digital Omnibus on AI, Legislative Legitimacy and the Dynamics of AI Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15662)
*Donal Casey,Liane Colonna*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了欧盟《人工智能数字综合法案》对《人工智能法案》的修订动因，通过立法合法性视角分析了技术变革、社会技术格局演变等动态因素，指出"AI监管竞赛""AI主导权竞赛"和"监管连接竞赛"三大动态造成了合法性困境，而该法案通过优先考虑政治与运营理性而非法律与文化理性来重塑合法性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解欧盟机构为何在《人工智能法案》生效不到两年就急于通过《人工智能数字综合法案》对其进行修订，探究这一立法修订背后的紧迫性和必要性。

Method: 采用立法合法性理论分析框架，从"AI监管竞赛""AI主导权竞赛"和"监管连接竞赛"三个维度审视欧盟AI监管面临的合法性困境，并分析《人工智能数字综合法案》如何通过优先政治和运营理性来解决这一困境。

Result: 识别出三大动态（AI监管竞赛、AI主导权竞赛、监管连接竞赛）构成了欧盟机构的合法性困境；《人工智能数字综合法案》通过优先考虑政治和运营理性而非法律和文化理性来重塑《人工智能法案》的合法性。

Conclusion: 《人工智能数字综合法案》的修订反映了欧盟在经济增长、竞争力、创新与监管简化压力下的立法调整，其本质是通过牺牲部分法律与文化理性来换取政治与运营层面的合法性，以适应快速变化的AI社会技术格局。

Abstract: Driving the Digital Omnibus on AI are growing concerns within the European Union about economic growth, competitiveness, innovation and regulatory simplification. What is particularly striking about the Digital Omnibus on AI is that it seeks to amend the AI Act that entered into force less than two years ago in August 2024. This raises the question of how we can understand both the need and urgency with which the European institutions have sought amend a centrepiece of EU legislation that is still in its infancy. In addressing this question, we examine the Digital Omnibus on AI through the lens of legislative legitimacy. In so doing, we ask how the specific dynamics of AI have shaped the legitimacy of AI regulation. Here, we are concerned not only with the issue of technological change, but with the broader dynamics of the evolving 'socio-technical landscape' of AI. In addressing this question, we argue that three specific dynamics have created a legitimacy dilemma for the EU institutions in the context of the AI Act: the race for AI regulation; the race for AI dominance and; the race for regulatory connection. As a response and proposed solution to this legitimacy dilemma, we further contend that, as a solution to the legitimacy dilemma caused by these three dynamics, the Digital Omnibus on AI in turn reshapes the legitimacy of the AI Act as it prioritises political and operational rationalities over legal and cultural rationalities.

</details>


### [382] [From Distorted Mirrors to Sovereign Reflections: Resisting the Grotesque Depiction of Our Digital Selves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15728)
*Andreas Komninos,Gerasimos Vonitsanos,Spyros Sioutas*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判了当前环境智能与数字基础设施下的个人数据主权危机，指出现有法律框架（如GDPR）仅规制原始数据而未能挑战算法推断的垄断，导致数据孤岛造成认知截肢、本体暴力和自我审查。作者主张通过去殖民化的基础设施保障算法身份的功能可转移性，实现后人类自我的解放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境智能的普及使人类生活与数字基础设施密不可分，但平台通过数据殖民主义和榨取主义将人类经验视为无主之地，构建了孤立的专有用户模型，引发了个人数据主权危机。现有法律框架未能解决这种权力不对称。

Method: 采用批判后人类主义视角，结合娱乐、电子商务、金融科技和远程信息处理四个当代场景进行论证分析。

Result: 指出数据孤岛导致了认知截肢、本体暴力和自我审查三种危害；现有法律（如欧盟数字权利和GDPR）因仅规制原始数据而放任算法推断垄断，无法解决权力不对称。

Conclusion: 确保数字权利需要超越防御性监管，转向去殖民化的基础设施架构，保证算法身份的可功能转移，从而将技术重新用于后人类自我的解放。

Abstract: As Ambient Intelligence weaves computing into everyday life, human existence has become inextricably linked to ubiquitous digital infrastructures, triggering a crisis of personal data sovereignty. Driven by extractivism and data colonialism, platforms exploit human experience as a terra nullius, enclosing proprietary user models within isolated silos. We argue that legal frameworks like the EU Digital Rights and GDPR fail to counter this power asymmetry because they regulate inert raw data while leaving monopolies over algorithmic inferences unchallenged. Consequently, current architectures act as funhouse mirrors, creating a grotesque, distorted depiction of our digital selves. Through critical posthumanism and four contemporary scenarios (entertainment, e-commerce, fintech, and telematics), this paper illustrates how data siloing inflicts cognitive amputation, ontological violence, and self-censorship. We argue that securing digital rights requires moving beyond defensive regulation toward a decolonial infrastructure that guarantees the functional transferability of algorithmic identities, reclaiming technology for the emancipation of the posthuman self.

</details>


### [383] [Classifying by Proxy: Explainable and Reproducible Ensemble of Proxy Tasks for Child Sexual Abuse Imagery Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15993)
*Clara Ernesto,Carlos Caetano,Sandra Avila,João Macedo,Camila Laranjeira,Leo S. F. Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于代理任务集成的方法用于儿童性虐待图像（CSAI）分类，在提高可解释性、可复现性和安全性的同时，在RCPD数据集上实现了91.9%的平衡准确率，并优于DINO等表示学习模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CSAI分类系统对于减轻执法人员审查这些材料时的心理负担以及从网络上高效移除这些材料至关重要。然而，由于图像高度敏感、数据集访问受限，导致研究难以复现、比较和验证。此外，现有模型普遍缺乏执法人员所需的可解释性。

Method: 采用代理任务集成方法，选取与CSAI分类相关的代理任务进行组合训练，并针对原始框架进行训练适应。首次将这一概念应用于真实CSAI数据。

Result: 在RCPD数据集上，最佳代理任务组合达到91.9%的平衡准确率，优于DINO表示学习模型。同时，该集成方法提供了分类结果的解释性。

Conclusion: 代理任务集成方法在CSAI分类任务上具有竞争力，并且相比于单一深度学习模型，在可解释性、可复现性和安全分发方面具有显著优势。

Abstract: Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI) classification systems are needed solutions for lessening the psychological impacts often felt by law enforcement agents responsible for evaluating these materials and for efficient removal of these materials from the web. However, due to the nature of the task, researching and developing such systems is not a trivial endeavor. The images are highly sensitive, and the related datasets are under restrictive access regimes, which means most studies in the area are not reproducible or distributable and are therefore hard to compare and validate. More concerning still, most models for this task today lack an aspect often desired by law enforcement agents: explainability. In this paper, we apply an ensemble of Proxy Tasks -- tasks that correlate to CSAI classification -- yielding improvements in reproducibility, explainability, and security for distribution. This concept is applied for the first time to real CSAI, with a novel selection of relevant Proxy Tasks (selected from the CSAI literature) and training adaptations to the original framework. Our final model achieves competitive results, yielding 91.9% balanced accuracy on the RCPD dataset with the best Proxy Task combination. We furthermore contrast these results with the best-in-class representation learning model, DINO, and show that our ensemble improves accuracy and provides explanations for its classification results, a feature that a single deep learning model can seldom provide.

</details>


### [384] [How to Detect and Measure the AI Dangers to Democracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16054)
*Giulia Sandri,Claudio Novelli*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出将委托-代理理论与NIST AI风险管理框架相结合，构建一个分析框架，系统评估人工智能对民主进程的风险，并以机构可评估性作为民主控制的核心条件。研究指出，AI并未创造新的民主问题，而是加剧了现有问题，当前方法无法处理危害严重性和可接受风险程度的价值判断问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献普遍认为AI加剧了民主问题（信息生态、选举、公共行政等领域），但缺乏系统化优先排序风险、跨域比较以及识别民主控制最可能失效环节的方法。作者试图解决如何系统化AI系统对民主进程造成的问题这一核心难题。

Method: 以委托-代理理论为核心分析工具，将AI视为民主体系中的委托问题；结合NIST AI风险管理框架的七大可信AI特征（提供实质性评价标准）；跨三个领域（信息生态、选举、公共行政）操作化可衡量指标和领域特定的可信度标准；以机构可评估性作为民主控制AI的核心条件。

Result: 提出了一个以委托-代理理论为框架、以NIST可信AI特征为评价标准、以机构可评估性为核心条件的分析框架，可用于实证评估AI对民主的影响。同时识别出一个关键局限：当前方法无法处理危害严重性和可接受风险程度的价值判断问题，尤其是在这些判断被（无声地）委托给私人供应商时更为突出。

Conclusion: 委托-代理理论适用于系统化AI对民主进程的风险，但价值判断（危害严重性、可接受风险程度）问题尚未解决，这是未来工作的重要方向。

Abstract: Research on artificial intelligence and democracy has grown quickly over the last decade. A shared conclusion in this literature is that AI does not create new democratic problems so much as it makes old ones worse. We now see this across information ecosystems, in elections, and in public administration. However, despite growing evidence, we lack a clear way to prioritize risks in this area, compare them across domains, and identify where democratic control is most likely to break down. So, our problem is: How can we systematize the problems that AI systems pose to democratic processes? This paper argues that principal agent theory may fit the task. In many phases of democratic systems, principals delegate key functions to AI systems and their providers without really being able to monitor how these systems operate or the outputs they produce. Treating AI as a delegation problem helps identify accountability gaps and other governance failures. Most importantly, as we shall illustrate, it provides metrics for empirical assessments of AI impact on democracy. As a second analytical element, we draw on the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and its seven characteristics of trustworthy AI, which supply substantive criteria for evaluating delegated tasks. Operationalized across the three domains through measurable indicators and domain specific trustworthiness criteria, we propose an analytical framework that centers on institutional assessability as the central condition for democratic control over AI. However, we stress that how severe a harm is, and how much risk is acceptable, are evaluative judgments that current methodologies neither acknowledge nor operationalize. This becomes acute when such evaluative judgments are (silently) delegated to private vendors. We identify this as a strong limitation left for future work.

</details>


### [385] [AI systems out-persuade expert humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16475)
*Kobi Hackenburg,Caroline Wagner,Luke Hewitt,Ben M. Tappin,Ed Saunders,Hannah Rose Kirk,Helen Margetts,Christopher Summerfield*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过一系列预注册实验（n=18,978次对话），研究发现前沿AI系统在说服力上显著超越包括专业辩论冠军、职业游说者在内的各类人类专家，其优势源于快速部署大量信息的能力；即使经过针对性训练，人类专家仍无法匹敌AI，且AI在真实募捐场景中的效果是专业人员的近3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验对话式AI是否能在高激励、高技能的人类专家（如专业辩论冠军、职业游说者）面前展现出更强的说服能力，填补现有研究在AI与高度激励专家对比方面的空白。

Method: 四项预注册实验，共包含18,978次对话（来自6,923名参与者），将AI与不同层级人类说服者（普通人、说服锦标赛冠军、职业游说者、世界辩论冠军）进行对抗；随后引入AI约束条件（限制响应速度和消息长度）进行对比；最后在真实募捐场景中检验AI与职业游说者的表现。

Result: AI系统在所有实验中均可靠地优于人类专家；即使人类专家经过针对性训练（包括对抗AI、复盘历史、查看AI在关键节点的回应），仍无法超越AI；当AI被限制到人类响应速度和消息长度时，训练后的人类专家才能与AI持平；在真实募捐中，AI效果是专业人员的近3倍。

Conclusion: 前沿AI系统在对话中能够超越最优秀的人类专家，其优势核心在于快速部署大量信息的能力；这一发现对政治沟通等领域具有重要影响。

Abstract: Many societal decisions are settled by contests of persuasion. Conversational AI is a powerful new entrant in these contests, but whether it can out-persuade skilled and highly incentivized humans has remained unclear. Here, in a series of four preregistered experiments (n = 18,978 conversations from 6,923 people), we pitted AI systems against a range of human persuaders, including laypeople, winners of a separately preregistered four-round online persuasion tournament, professional canvassers, and world championship debaters. We found that AI systems were reliably more persuasive than expert humans, even when expert humans chose their issues, researched in advance, underwent hours of live, structured practice, and were incentivized with £1,000 cash bonuses. In a follow-up study, AI's advantage persisted after experts received a coaching tool that let them practice against the AI that beat them, review their performance history, and see what AI would have said at key moments. We found converging evidence that AI's advantage stemmed from rapidly deploying larger quantities of information: after coaching, expert humans could tie an AI constrained to respond at human speeds and with human-length messages. In a final study, we show that AI's advantage extends to consequential real-world behavior: AI was nearly 3x more effective than professional canvassers from a UK fundraising firm at raising real-money donations to Save the Children. Together, these results establish that frontier AI systems out-persuade expert humans in conversation, with significant implications for political communication.

</details>


### [386] [From Newtonian to Relativistic IAM: The Autonomous Principal as Reference Frame for Digital Identity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17002)
*Philippe Page,Robert Mitwicki,Michal Pietrus*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证自主主体（autonomous principal）不是数据治理中的规范性偏好，而是分布式信息系统中认真对待因果性的必然结果。类比从牛顿物理到相对论的转变，指出托管式身份管理依赖全局同时性假设，该假设在跨生态系统、跨司法管辖区和线上线下边界时失效。放弃该假设后，状态从中央权威持有的名词转变为通过因果有序交换在主体间维持的关系。自主主体成为唯一有资格定义自身参考框架的实体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明分布式治理模型（自主主体作为交易主权所在）不是一种规范性偏好，而是将因果性严肃应用于分布式信息系统的逻辑必然结果。

Method: 采用物理类比（牛顿力学→相对论）进行结构论证；基于2023年以来实际构建的技术系统进行验证。

Result: 托管式身份管理隐含全局同时性假设，该假设在跨生态系统/司法管辖区/线上线下边界时失效；状态需重新定义为因果有序交换中主体间的关系；自主主体是唯一有资格定义自身参考框架的实体。

Conclusion: 自主主体模型是分布式信息系统中因果性要求的必然结论，该模型对跨境数据流和智能体系统具有重要影响。

Abstract: The 2023 paper \emph{Distributed Governance: a Principal-Agent Approach to Data Governance} arXiv:2308.07280 introduced the autonomous principal as the locus of transactional sovereignty in digital ecosystems. This follow-up, Part 2, advances a structural argument for why that model is not a normative preference but a consequence of taking causality seriously in distributed information systems. Drawing an analogy with the transition from Newtonian to relativistic physics, we show that custodial identity management rests on an implicit assumption of global simultaneity that fails as soon as identity must operate across ecosystems, jurisdictions, and the offline/online boundary. Once that assumption is dropped, state ceases to be a noun held by a central authority and becomes a relation maintained between principals through causally ordered exchanges. The autonomous principal emerges as the only entity with standing to define its own reference frame. We report on technology built since 2023 that operationalises this view, and outline its consequences for cross-border data flows and agentic systems.

</details>


### [387] [Precision Medicine for the Population-The Hope and Hype of Public Health Genomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13183)
*JunBo Wu,Nathaniel Comfort*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判“精准公共卫生”（PPH）过度强调基因组大数据在人群健康决策中的作用，通过对比进步时代（1890-1920）类似尝试，指出其可能加剧对弱势群体的伤害，建议优先整合从分子到社会多层级数据以规避风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示精准公共卫生（PPH）过度依赖基因组数据的潜在危害，尤其是对弱势群体的不公平影响，并通过历史比较警示其风险。

Method: 将PPH与进步时代（1890-1920）利用大数据和遗传学的早期尝试进行对比分析，结合历史文献论证过度强调遗传对弱势群体的伤害。

Result: PPH如同精准医学一样过度销售基因组数据在决定健康结果上的价值，且历史表明强调遗传倾向会不成比例地伤害未得到充分服务的少数群体和弱势社区。

Conclusion: 应避免基因驱动的预防性公共卫生风险，优先整合从分子到社会多层级的数据分析。

Abstract: Public health is the most recent of the biomedical sciences to be seduced by the trendy moniker "precision." Advocates for "precision public health" (PPH) call for a data-driven, computational approach to public health, leveraging swaths of genomic "big data" to inform public health decision-making. Yet, like precision medicine, PPH oversells the value of genomic data to determine health outcomes, but on a population-level. A large historical literature has shown that over-emphasizing heredity tends to disproportionately harm underserved minorities and disadvantaged communities. By comparing and contrasting PPH with an earlier attempt at using big data and genetics, in the Progressive era (1890-1920), we highlight some potential risks of a genotype-driven preventive public health. We conclude by suggesting that such risks may be avoided by prioritizing data integration across many levels of analysis, from the molecular to the social.

</details>


### [388] [Toward Integrated Solutions: A Systematic Interdisciplinary Review of Cybergrooming Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05727)
*Heajun An,Marcos Silva,Qi Zhang,Arav Singh,Minqian Liu,Xinyi Zhang,Sarvech Qadir,Sang Won Lee,Lifu Huang,Pamela J. Wisniewski,Jin-Hee Cho*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了网络诱骗（Cybergrooming）领域的社会科学与计算方法，指出两者整合不足，并基于PRISMA框架提出跨学科协作方向，以提升预防与检测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络诱骗研究在社会行为分析与计算检测方法之间呈现碎片化，缺乏系统性整合，阻碍了全面预防策略的制定。

Method: 采用PRISMA框架对社会科学（定性方法）与计算科学（机器学习检测）两类文献进行系统性综述，提升可重复性与跨学科协作。

Result: 发现定性方法洞察深但资源密集，机器学习模型依赖数据质量，标准评估指标难以应对类别不平衡与文化差异问题。

Conclusion: 弥合两大领域间的鸿沟可促进跨学科网络诱拐研究，为更有效的预防与检测策略提供指导。

Abstract: Cybergrooming exploits minors through online trust-building, yet research remains fragmented, limiting holistic prevention. Social sciences focus on behavioral insights, while computational methods emphasize detection, but their integration remains insufficient. This review systematically synthesizes both fields using the PRISMA framework to enhance clarity, reproducibility, and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Findings show that qualitative methods offer deep insights but are resource-intensive, machine learning models depend on data quality, and standard metrics struggle with imbalance and cultural nuances. By bridging these gaps, this review advances interdisciplinary cybergrooming research, guiding future efforts toward more effective prevention and detection strategies.

</details>


### [389] [Position Paper: Unlocking the Potential of AI Researchers in Scientific Discovery-What Is Missing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05822)
*Hengjie Yu,Shuya Liu,Haiyun Yang,Yuping Yan,Maozhen Qu,Yaochu Jin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: AI for Science（AI4Science）在Nature Index期刊中的发文量过去十年增长了15倍，但目前仍仅占总发文量的不到3%。基于创新扩散理论，预测其占比将从2024年的2.72%上升至2050年的约20%。然而，近95%的AI驱动研究由实验科学家主导，AI研究者的潜力远未被充分挖掘。为此，本文提出结构化工作流和战略干预，通过三条关键路径赋能AI研究者成为科学发现的核心驱动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI研究者在科学发现中的潜力远未被充分挖掘；尽管AI4Science发文量快速增长，但其占比仍然很低（<3%），且绝大多数AI驱动研究由实验科学家主导（~95%），AI研究者尚未成为科学发现的核心力量。

Method: 基于创新扩散理论（Diffusion of Innovation）进行预测分析，提出三条战略路径：1) 为实验科学家提供易用的AI工具以放大AI研究者的影响力；2) 弥合认知和方法论鸿沟，使AI研究者更直接参与科学发现；3) 主动培育繁荣的AI驱动科学生态系统。

Result: 预测AI4Science发文占比将从2024年的2.72%增长至2050年的约20%；识别出AI研究者未被充分参与的关键瓶颈（95%由实验科学家主导）；提出三条赋能路径。

Conclusion: 通过结构化工作流和战略干预，可以充分发挥AI研究者的潜力，使其成为未来科学突破的关键驱动力，推动AI4Science从边缘走向主流。

Abstract: The potential of AI researchers in scientific discovery remains largely untapped. Over the past decade, AI for Science (AI4Science) publications in 145 Nature Index journals have increased fifteen-fold, yet they still account for less than 3% of the total publications. Drawing upon the Diffusion of Innovation theory, we project AI4Science's share of total publications to rise from 2.72% in 2024 to approximately 20% by 2050. Achieving this shift requires fully harnessing the potential of AI researchers, as nearly 95% of AI-driven research in these journals is led by experimental scientists. To facilitate this, we propose structured workflows and strategic interventions to position AI researchers at the forefront of scientific discovery. Specifically, we identify three critical pathways: equipping experimental scientists with accessible AI tools to amplify the impact of AI researchers, bridging cognitive and methodological gaps to enable more direct involvement in scientific discovery, and proactively fostering a thriving AI-driven scientific ecosystem. By addressing these challenges, we aim to empower AI researchers as key drivers of future scientific breakthroughs.

</details>


### [390] [If open source is to win, it must go public](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09296)
*Joshua Tan,Nicholas Vincent,Katherine Elkins,Magnus Sahlgren,Joseph Low,David Pham,Sampo Pyysalo,Jenia Jitsev*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了开源AI面临资源门槛高、可持续性差等挑战，提出必须建设公共AI基础设施和机构来补充开源AI，确保AI模型作为公共产品服务于公众利益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源AI虽然在模型和系统方面取得了显著进展，但由于预训练、后训练和部署所需的数据与计算资源巨大，仅有少数参与者能够承担，导致AI民主化面临瓶颈。作者旨在呼吁通过公共AI基础设施来弥补开源模式的不足。

Method: 采用立场论文（position paper）的论述方式，通过对比开源软件与开源AI的本质差异（激活与维护成本），论证公共AI的必要性，提出建设公共基础设施和机构来支撑开源模型的全生命周期。

Result: 指出开源AI无法单独实现AI的完全民主化，需要公共AI作为互补力量；公共AI能够提供可持续的资源供给和符合公共利益的治理机制。

Conclusion: 为了实现AI模型作为亲社会公共产品的全部潜力，必须建设公共基础设施来驱动和交付开源软件与模型，形成"开源+公共"的双轨模式。

Abstract: Open source projects have made incredible progress in producing widely usable machine learning models and systems, but open source alone will face challenges in fully democratizing access to AI. Unlike previous generations of open source software, open source and open weight AI models require substantial resources to activate and maintain -- e.g., data and compute for pre-training, post-training, and deployment -- which only a few actors can currently provide. This position paper argues that open source AI must be complemented by public AI: infrastructure and institutions that ensure models are accessible, sustainable, and governed in the public interest. To achieve the full promise of AI models as prosocial public goods, we need to build public infrastructure to power and deliver open source software and models.

</details>


### [391] [Prototyping an AI-powered Tool for Energy Efficiency in New Zealand Homes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05364)
*Abdollah Baghaei Daemei*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一个基于AI的新西兰住宅能效决策支持工具原型，该工具集成数据摄取、异常检测、基线建模和情景模拟功能，通过15位专家测试获得可用性(4.3/5)和情景输出价值(4.5/5)的高评分，表明其能有效弥合政策补贴与家庭实际决策之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新西兰住宅建筑能效低下、保温不足和供暖效率差导致能源困难普遍存在，尽管已有"Warmer Kiwi Homes"等改革措施，但改造仍不全面、家庭绩效数据有限、房主决策支持碎片化，亟需一个整合的决策支持工具。

Method: 基于Python和Streamlit开发AI决策支持工具原型，包含数据摄取、异常检测、基线建模和场景模拟（如LED改造、保温升级）模块化仪表盘；通过15位领域专家（建筑科学家、顾问、政策实践者）的半结构化访谈进行测试评估。

Result: 工具获得高可用性评分（M=4.3）、情景输出价值评分（M=4.5），专家对其补充补贴计划和监管框架的潜力持积极态度。

Conclusion: 该工具展示了AI如何将国家政策转化为个性化的家庭层面指导，弥合资金、标准与实际决策之间的鸿沟，为减少能源困难、改善健康结果和支持气候目标提供了可复制的框架。未来应关注碳排放指标、电价建模、国家数据集整合及纵向试验以评估实际应用效果。

Abstract: Residential buildings contribute significantly to energy use, health outcomes, and carbon emissions. In New Zealand, housing quality has historically been poor, with inadequate insulation and inefficient heating contributing to widespread energy hardship. Recent reforms, including the Warmer Kiwi Homes program, Healthy Homes Standards, and H1 Building Code upgrades, have delivered health and comfort improvements, yet challenges persist. Many retrofits remain partial, data on household performance are limited, and decision-making support for homeowners is fragmented. This study presents the design and evaluation of an AI-powered decision-support tool for residential energy efficiency in New Zealand. The prototype, developed using Python and Streamlit, integrates data ingestion, anomaly detection, baseline modeling, and scenario simulation (e.g., LED retrofits, insulation upgrades) into a modular dashboard. Fifteen domain experts, including building scientists, consultants, and policy practitioners, tested the tool through semi-structured interviews. Results show strong usability (M = 4.3), high value of scenario outputs (M = 4.5), and positive perceptions of its potential to complement subsidy programs and regulatory frameworks. The tool demonstrates how AI can translate national policies into personalized, household-level guidance, bridging the gap between funding, standards, and practical decision-making. Its significance lies in offering a replicable framework for reducing energy hardship, improving health outcomes, and supporting climate goals. Future development should focus on carbon metrics, tariff modeling, integration with national datasets, and longitudinal trials to assess real-world adoption.

</details>


### [392] [Can Artificial Intelligence Accelerate Technological Progress? Researchers' Perspectives on AI in Manufacturing and Materials Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14007)
*John P. Nelson,Olajide Olugbade,Philip Shapira,Justin B. Biddle*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对32位美国制造业与材料科学领域研究人员的访谈，发现AI/ML主要用于材料和制造过程建模，加速了设计空间搜索，带来成本、时间和计算资源的节省，但在数据稀疏区域可靠性不足，需与传统方法结合使用，且可能阻碍颠覆性理论突破。研究认为AI/ML有助于维持性创新加速，但需同时支持传统研究以确保颠覆性进步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI被视为能大幅加速技术进步，但这些预期往往缺乏对AI在创新过程中实际应用的详细研究，因此AI究竟如何以及在多大程度上能加速创新仍不清晰，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 对32位美国学术界的制造业和材料科学研究人员（均有AI/ML经验）进行半结构化访谈，收集并分析其使用AI/ML的经验和看法。

Result: 1) AI主要用于材料和制造过程的建模，实现更廉价、更快速的设计空间搜索；2) 带来成本、时间和计算资源的节省；3) 但AI/ML在数据密集的设计空间之外不可靠，需要与旧有研究技术结合使用；4) 存在AI可能绕过颠覆性理论进步机会的担忧。

Conclusion: AI/ML有望加速维持性创新，但若要保持制造业和材料科学领域进一步的颠覆性进步，仍需同时支持传统的实证、计算和理论研究。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) raises expectations of substantial increases in rates of technological progress, but such anticipations are often not connected to detailed ground-level studies of AI use in innovation processes. Accordingly, it remains unclear how and to what extent AI can accelerate innovation. To help to fill this gap, we explore and assess results from 32 interviews with U.S.-based academic manufacturing and materials sciences researchers experienced with AI and machine learning (ML) techniques. We found that AI was primarily used for modeling of materials and manufacturing processes, facilitating cheaper and more rapid search of design spaces for materials and manufacturing processes alike. Benefits included cost, time, and computation savings in technology development. However, AI/ML tools were unreliable outside design spaces for which dense data were already available; they required skilled and judicious application in tandem with older research techniques; and concerns were raised about the potential to detrimentally circumvent opportunities for disruptive theoretical advancement. Based on these results, we suggest there is reason for optimism about acceleration in sustaining innovations through the use of AI/ML; but that support for conventional empirical, computational, and theoretical research is required to maintain the likelihood of further disruptive advances in manufacturing and materials.

</details>


### [393] [Critically Engaged Pragmatism: Scientific Norm and Social, Pragmatist Epistemology for AI Science Evaluation Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09753)
*Carole J. Lee*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"批判性参与实用主义"作为科学规范，要求科学界审视AI科学评估工具的目的和目的特定可靠性，并主张工具创建者应透明、完整地报告设计、训练和基准细节，以促进对工具可靠性、错误类型和偏见的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统指标（如影响因子）存在去语境化和不当使用的问题，AI科学评估工具同样面临此类风险。作者旨在提出一种规范框架，防止AI评估工具被误用为客观的科研质量仲裁者。

Method: 提出"批判性参与实用主义"（Critically-Engaged Pragmatism）作为科学规范，要求科学社区对AI评估工具的目的和目的特定可靠性进行审视。同时主张工具创建者应透明报告设计、训练和基准细节，并随新错误形式、偏见和博弈行为的发现而更新最佳实践。

Result: 该框架将AI科学评估工具从客观的科研可信度仲裁者重新定义为批判性话语实践的客体，其可信度最终由科学社区的批判性讨论所奠基。

Conclusion: AI科学评估工具不应被视为客观的科研评价标准，而应成为科学社区批判性讨论的对象。通过透明报告和持续的规范更新，可以更负责任地使用这些工具。

Abstract: AI science evaluation tools aim to assess research credibility. As with traditional metrics such as impact factors, their edicts can be decontextualised and repurposed in problematic ways. To address this, I propose Critically-Engaged Pragmatism as a scientific norm enjoining scientific communities to scrutinise the purposes and purpose-specific reliability of AI science evaluation tools. To foster Critically Engaged Pragmatism, creators of AI science evaluation tools should transparently and fully report design, training, and benchmarking details to facilitate assessments of purpose-specific reliability, liability to different types of error, and bias. What count as best practices for the transparent reporting of AI science evaluation tools should be updated as new forms of error, bias, and gamesmanship are discovered. Under this framework, AI science evaluation tools are not objective arbiters of scientific credibility. Rather, they are the object of critical discursive practices that ultimately ground the credibility of scientific communities.

</details>


### [394] [Faster Completion, Less Learning: Generative AI Reduced Study Time on Math Problems and the Knowledge They Build](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21629)
*Sina Rismanchian,Hasan Uzun,Jeffrey Matayoshi,Eric Cosyn,Eyad Kurd-Misto*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 基于320万条ALEKS学习交互数据的十年面板分析，结合准实验设计，发现ChatGPT发布后学生在易受AI影响的文本问题上的学习时间每季度下降2.8%（大学生），累积达26.9%，而监考条件下该差异完全消失；逻辑斯蒂固定效应模型显示监考保留题正确率累积下降25%，非监考评估则出现相反的大幅上升，表明生成式AI已改变学生学习方式和知识构建，揭示了"认知投降"的人口层面指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我报告调查显示变化很小，而小规模行为研究报告广泛使用AI但缺乏测量学习后果的规模和时长，因此需要大规模、长期的行为和结果证据来回答生成式AI如何改变学生学习过程及影响其持久学习成果。

Method: 使用十年面板数据（320万条ALEKS学习交互）进行时间任务分析，结合ALEKS PPL分班评估数据检测监考和学习成果，采用准实验设计利用对AI更敏感（文本应用题）和更不敏感（交互式图表问题）的任务变异。

Result: 大学生在AI敏感问题上的学习时间每季度下降2.8%，累积11个季度下降26.9%；高中生下降31.3%，初中生9.0%，五年级学生无显著变化。监考条件下差异完全消失。监考保留题正确率累积下降25%，非监考评估则出现相反的大幅上升。

Conclusion: 这是首批大规模行为与结果证据，表明生成式AI已改变了学生学习方式和知识构建，揭示了"认知投降"的人口层面指标，对教育研究、评估治理和AI政策有直接影响。

Abstract: How much have students' ordinary learning processes shifted in response to generative AI, and how does that affect their durable learning outcomes? Self-report surveys show little change, while small-scale behavioral studies report widespread AI use without the scale or duration to measure learning consequences. We address both questions using a ten-year panel of $3.2$ million ALEKS learning interactions for investigating time-on-task, complemented by ALEKS PPL placement-assessment data for examining proctoring and learning outcomes, with a quasi-experimental design exploiting variation in tasks that are more susceptible to AI (text-based word problems) and less susceptible to AI (interactive graph-based problems). Learning time on AI-susceptible problems declines $2.8\%$ per quarter among college students after ChatGPT's release, cumulating to $26.9\%$ over eleven quarters; high-schoolers show $31.3\%$, middle-schoolers $9.0\%$, and Grade 5 students no detectable change. Among college students, the post-ChatGPT divergence vanishes entirely under proctoring, ruling out broad efficiency gains as the likely explanation. Logistic fixed-effects models on randomly assigned proctored retention items yield a $25\%$ cumulative decline in odds of correct response; the same estimator on non-proctored assessment produces a large opposite-signed increase -- inconsistent with any platform, cohort, or curriculum explanation. These results are among the first large-scale behavioral and outcome evidence that generative AI has altered how students study and the knowledge they build -- the population-level indicator of \emph{cognitive surrender}, with direct implications for educational research, assessment governance, and AI policy.

</details>


### [395] [The Fair Lending Model: How the Longest-Running Algorithmic Fairness Programs Work in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02957)
*Emily Black,Miranda Bogen,Logan Koepke,Solon Barocas,Wesley Deng,Mingwei Hsu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过35个半结构化访谈，首次实证揭示了美国金融机构在公平借贷法律下如何测试和缓解算法歧视，发现监管审查是推动合规的关键因素，而具体实践存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管美国金融机构执行公平借贷法律已有数十年，但学界对其实践操作知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供公平借贷项目实际运作的实证描述。

Method: 对公平借贷生态系统的参与者进行35次半结构化访谈，分析金融机构如何测试和缓解算法歧视。

Result: 金融机构具备防止歧视的基本实践（这方面优于其他领域），但具体测试方法和寻找更公平算法的策略差异很大。监管审查是合规工作的主要驱动力，但实际效果取决于机构能否平衡商业利益、法律张力与监管不确定性。

Conclusion: 监管权威在促进公平借贷实践中发挥了独特且成功的作用，这一设计特征区别于其他民权法领域，且在近期应对算法歧视的政策提案中几乎完全缺失。

Abstract: U.S. financial institutions subject to fair lending laws have been running algorithmic fairness programs for decades. Despite this long history, remarkably little is known about how these requirements operate in practice. In this paper, we offer the first empirical account of how financial institutions test for and mitigate algorithmic discrimination on the ground. In doing so, we shed light on how the regulatory design of fair lending law and regulation have shaped the policies, processes, and practices of fair lending programs. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with participants across the fair lending ecosystem, we find that while financial institutions have a floor of fairness practices aimed at preventing discrimination in lending largely absent in other domains, the specifics of how firms test for discrimination and search for less discriminatory algorithms varies widely. We also find that regulatory supervision via fair lending examinations has been the key driver of compliance work, but that the practical impact of fair lending programs often depends on how well they can navigate competing business incentives, perceived legal tensions, and regulatory uncertainty. Ultimately, our findings highlight the unique role that supervisory authority has played in successfully fostering fair lending practices -- a regulatory design feature that is distinct from other areas of civil rights law and almost completely absent from recent policy proposals for dealing with algorithmic discrimination.

</details>


### [396] [It's Safer to Give Personhood to Bears than to Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12440)
*John P. Nelson*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI权利的制度维度：赋予AI道德或法律权利意味着什么，以及由此带来的机遇与危险。与人类赋予权利的其他非人类实体不同，AI系统在原则上能够无需人类帮助和中介就获取并行使制度权力。拥有权利的AI能合法地、拥有权力的AI能不可阻挡地损害人类利益。因此，即使给相当笨拙的AI系统赋予权利，也会将人类命运与潜在不可预测的非人类绑定。作者主张，赋予AI主张或行使固有权利，将是一场关乎人类自决权的世界历史性赌博，任何个人研究者、公司、国家甚至国际组织都没有道德权利授权这样做。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有大量关于AI是否应拥有权利的研究，但对AI权利在实践中意味着什么的探讨较少。本文旨在填补这一空白，从制度维度分析承认AI道德或法律权利所需的条件及其后果。

Method: 概念分析和思想实验。通过比较AI与其他非人类实体（如公司、动物）的权利制度差异，论证AI获取和行使制度权力的独特能力所带来的风险。

Result: 论证了AI权利的制度化将导致人类自决权受到威胁，因为AI能够自主获取和行使制度权力，且这种风险无法通过现有治理机制（如国家或国际组织）来合理化授权。

Conclusion: 赋予AI固有权利是一场威胁人类自决权的世界历史性赌博，没有任何行为体拥有道德权利来授权这一转变。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) developers are rhetorically flirting with the idea that AI systems might have interests or moral rights. While there has been a large volume of research on whether AI deserves rights, there has been less exploration of what AI rights would mean in practice. This paper explores the institutional dimension of AI rights: what it would take to recognize moral or legal rights for AIs, and the attendant opportunities and dangers. Unlike all other nonhuman entities to which humanity has extended rights, AI systems are in principle capable of acquiring and wielding institutional power without human aid and mediation. AIs with rights would be able to legitimately, and AIs with power able to unpreventably, abridge human interests. Accordingly, giving rights even to rather dumb AI systems would entail binding the fate of humanity to potentially unpredictable nonhumans. Accordingly, I defend the rather grandiose claim that to empower AI to claim or to exercise inherent rights would be a world-historical gamble with human self-determination, which no individual researcher, firm, state, or even international organization has the moral right to authorize.

</details>


### [397] [Incentives Of EdTech: A Systematic Review Of EduNLP Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13691)
*Gabrielle Gaudeau,Aoife O'Driscoll,Jasper Degraeuwe,Andrew Caines,Donya Rooein,Zeerak Talat*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对ACL教育应用领域204篇论文的系统综述，发现教育NLP研究存在利益相关者失衡：教师作为最受影响群体仅33.3%被纳入受益者，实际部署率仅9.8%，伦理参与流于表面，反映了私营部门激励与教育基础设施需求之间的张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管NLP社区投入大量资源开发教育技术，但谁的利益在利益相关者中得到最好服务尚不明确，因此需要系统审视研究的利益分配格局。

Method: 对2024-2025年ACL教育应用领域204篇论文进行系统性文献综述，并与更广泛的ACL文集中的教育技术论文进行交叉验证。通过分析利益相关者纳入情况和研究任务优先级来揭示问题。

Result: 教师作为最受影响群体仅33.3%被纳入研究受益者；实际部署案例仅占9.8%；伦理参与多为"承认"而非"行动"层面。

Conclusion: 研究存在私营部门激励与教育基础设施需求之间的张力，并基于优秀范例提出了更负责任的教育NLP研究实践建议。

Abstract: While the Natural Language Processing community has dedicated significant resources in developing educational technologies (EdTech) that support this shift, it remains unclear whose interests are being best served among the stakeholders of education.
  In this paper, we present a systematic literature review of 204 papers published in venues of the Association for Computational Linguistics' Special Interest Group on Building Educational Applications in 2024 and 2025, and validate these against EdTech papers from the wider ACL Anthology. By examining stakeholder inclusion and the prioritisation of research tasks, our findings reveal a critical tension: a push and pull between private-sector incentives and the foundational needs of educational infrastructure. Our analysis reveals that teachers are systematically under-represented as beneficiaries of research (33.3%) despite being the most affected, that real-world deployment remains rare (9.8%), and that ethical engagement tends toward acknowledgement rather than action. Drawing on exemplary papers in our corpus, we offer concrete recommendations for more responsible EduNLP research practices.

</details>

### [398] [Can We Unmask the Underground? Detecting and Predicting Hidden Forum Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14880)
*Abdoul Nasser Hassane Amadou,Imane Fouad,Anas Motii*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出HADES无监督框架，利用预训练语言模型对地下论坛用户的文本交互进行语义嵌入和聚类，能够同时检测主导型和隐藏型威胁社区，在三个主流论坛上验证了有效性，并可在社区形成前一年就预测其出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下论坛中威胁社区识别对网络威胁情报至关重要，但传统基于图的方法只能识别主导群体，难以发现动态、隐蔽的小型子群体，存在检测盲区。

Method: 构建无监督框架HADES，基于用户文本交互使用预训练语言模型（如BERT）生成语义嵌入，编码潜在的行为和主题模式，通过语义相似性聚类并分配主题标签来识别威胁社区。

Result: 在HackForums、Cracked和BreachForums三个论坛上，BERT嵌入在聚类一致性和轮廓系数上均优于基线；识别出数十个不同社区，包括传统方法遗漏的少于100人的小型专业子群体；语义模式追踪可提前一年预测社区形成。

Conclusion: HADES通过语义分析有效弥补了传统图方法在检测隐藏社区方面的不足，且共享主题兴趣先于结构连接出现，使该方法具备社区形成的早期预测能力，提升了网络威胁情报的主动性和覆盖范围。

Abstract: Cybercriminal underground forums enable anonymous collaboration, allowing users to trade illicit tools, discuss vulnerabilities, and distribute stolen data. Driven by shared interests and specialized skills, users on these platforms organize into distinct threat communities. However, identifying these communities is challenging due to their dynamic and opaque structures; traditional graph-based methods typically isolate dominant groups while overlooking smaller, hidden subgroups. This paper introduces HADES, an unsupervised framework designed to detect both dominant and hidden communities in underground forums. The framework models users based on their textual interactions and leverages pretrained language models to generate semantic embeddings that encode latent behavioral and thematic patterns. By clustering users based on semantic similarity and assigning topic labels to the resulting clusters, HADES identifies specific threat communities to support Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI). The framework was evaluated on three major underground forums: HackForums, Cracked, and BreachForums. Results demonstrate that BERT embeddings consistently outperform alternative baselines, improving cluster coherence and achieving higher silhouette scores. Across these platforms, HADES identified dozens of distinct communities, effectively isolating small, specialized subgroups (fewer than 100 users) that evade traditional detection. Furthermore, because shared thematic interests frequently precede explicit structural connections, tracking these semantic patterns enables the framework to anticipate the formation of threat communities up to a year before they become detectable by traditional graph-based methods.

</details>


### [399] [Challenging Partisan Expectations Reduces Political Polarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15901)
*Do Won Kim,Ozgur Can Seckin,Saumya Bhadani,Alessandro Flammini,Giovanni Luca Ciampaglia,Bao Tran Truong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究提出预期违背（expectation violation）是政治接触削弱极化的重要机制：当对话违背“党派身份与政策立场一致”的预期时（如与立场相左的同党派成员或立场相同的异党派成员对话），能有效降低情感极化和议题极化，但这种效应在一个月后基本消失，且参与者体验满意度较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政治对话作为去极化手段的效果不一致，现有研究忽视了对话中“预期”这一关键因素。本文试图揭示预期违背如何影响政治接触的去极化效果。

Method: 采用2×2实验设计，1,983名美国成年人与AI聊天机器人进行结构化对话，独立操控聊天机器人呈现的党派身份（同党/异党）和政策立场（一致/对立），共四种条件。

Result: 预期违背条件（与立场相左的同党成员或立场相同的异党成员对话）有效降低了情感极化和议题极化；参与者自身政策立场无显著变化；一个月随访显示多数效应消失；对话维持或改善了客观审议质量，但参与者满意度较低。

Conclusion: 预期违背是一种未被充分探索的去极化机制；对话式AI可作为研究干预党派分歧的可扩展实验方法；但短期效果有限、体验满意度低等问题需进一步关注。

Abstract: Political conversations are often proposed as a remedy for political polarization, yet their effectiveness remains inconsistent. We argue that this inconsistency partly reflects a neglected feature of political contact: the expectations partisans bring to these encounters. We hypothesize that conversations should reduce political polarization the most when they violate the expected link between partisan identity and issue position. We test this hypothesis in a 2x2 experiment in which 1,983 U.S. adults engaged in structured conversations with an AI chatbot whose presented partisan identity and policy stance were independently manipulated. We find that expectation-challenging conversations in which participants talk with a disagreeing ingroup member or an agreeing outgroup member are effective in reducing affective and issue polarization. Although these effects emerge without meaningful shifts in participants' own policy positions, a follow-up survey shows that most effects disappear over one month. Interestingly, these conversations maintain or improve objective measures of deliberation but are experienced as less satisfying by participants. Our findings identify expectation violation as an underexplored depolarization mechanism. Our results also demonstrate the promises and limitations of how conversational AI can serve as a scalable method for experimentally studying interventions to mitigating partisan divides.

</details>


### [400] [Modeling Engagement with Brand and Organizational TikTok Videos Using Machine-Assisted Theory-Ensemble Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16053)
*Sander Paekivi,Andres Karjus*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文展示了如何利用多模态大语言模型（LLM）对约1万个TikTok短视频进行77个理论驱动的结构性变量（源自叙事学、修辞学、传播学与符号学）的自动标注，从而在账户规模和视频时长基线之上实现适度的内容分析与参与度预测提升。研究发现感知与传播变量编码可靠性较高，深层符号学与原型构念则更具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频因融合视听元素、语言及参与式、算法和趋势驱动的平台动态，难以规模化研究；人工标注繁琐且标准化困难，亟需自动化方法解决这一瓶颈。

Method: 利用多模态大语言模型对来自爱沙尼亚品牌和组织账户的约1万个TikTok视频进行77个理论驱动变量的自动标注，并通过人类验证评估编码可靠性，同时使用回归模型检验变量与参与度的关联。

Result: 多模态LLM在感知和传播变量上编码可靠性较好，深层符号学构念则可靠性较低；多数标注变量与平台成功无关，但部分变量在账户规模和视频时长基线之上对参与度预测有适度且一致的提升。

Conclusion: LLM的价值在于使大规模评估理论驱动变量成为可能，帮助识别有效信号并转化为面向创作者的针对性指导；该方法可支持文化分析、预测建模与内容诊断。

Abstract: Short-form video is difficult to study at scale because meaning emerges through audiovisual elements, language, and participatory, algorithmic and trend-based platform dynamics. Manual annotation of these layers is laborious at scale and difficult to standardize. We demonstrate how multimodal large language models (LLMs) can help address this bottleneck by annotating a set of 77 theory-driven structural variables derived from narratology, rhetoric, communication, and semiotics. We use this to explore content and estimate engagement with modest but consistent gains over account-size and video-age baselines in a corpus of about 10,000 TikTok videos of brand and organizational accounts from Estonia (covering a substantial share of the small country ecosystem). Human validation shows a reliability gradient: perceptual and communicative variables can be coded fairly reliably, while deeper semiotic and archetypal constructs are more difficult for both humans and machines. This approach of computational operationalization of long-standing interpretive theories can support several aims: exploratory cultural analytics of variation in short-form video culture, predictive modeling of platform dynamics, engagement, and audience feedback; and diagnostics for content creators to support choosing between structural and narrative strategies. Most annotated variables were not associated with platform success, as expected; the value of LLMs in this setting lies in making it feasible to assess large batteries of theoretically motivated variables, so that the subset carrying signal can be identified and translated into creator-facing guidance for a given niche.

</details>


### [401] [Exact Label Recovery in Euclidean Random Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.11163)
*Julia Gaudio,Charlie Guan,Xiaochun Niu,Ermin Wei*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出加权欧几里得随机图上的标签恢复问题家族，推导了精确标签恢复的信息论阈值（由Chernoff-Hellinger散度准则决定），并提出了一个高效的两阶段算法（局部传播+精炼），证明了阈值与"神谕估计器"性能一致，展现了局部到全局的放大现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为加权欧几里得随机图上的标签恢复问题建立统一的理论框架，将子矩阵定位、Z₂同步等经典问题推广到几何设定，并揭示其信息论极限。

Method: 采用Poisson点过程将顶点嵌入到R^d中，定义基于顶点标签和几何位置的边权分布；使用Chernoff-Hellinger散度准则确定阈值；不可恢复性通过Cramér下界证明；可恢复性通过两阶段算法（局部传播近似标定+精炼）证明。

Result: 在分布可区分性假设下，确定了精确标签恢复的信息论阈值；证明了阈值以下无法恢复，阈值以上可通过高效算法实现精确恢复；阈值由单顶点神谕估计器的性能决定。

Conclusion: 所提模型展现出局部到全局的放大现象，即全局恢复的阈值与局部神谕估计器的阈值一致；该框架统一了几何随机块模型等多个经典问题。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a family of label recovery problems on weighted Euclidean random graphs. The vertices of a graph are embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$ according to a Poisson point process, and are assigned to a discrete community label. Our goal is to infer the vertex labels, given edge weights whose distributions depend on the vertex labels as well as their geometric positions. Our general model provides a geometric extension of popular graph and matrix problems, including submatrix localization and $\mathbb{Z}_2$-synchronization, and includes the Geometric Stochastic Block Model (proposed by Sankararaman and Baccelli) as a special case. We study the fundamental limits of exact recovery of the vertex labels. Under a mild distinctness of distributions assumption, we determine the information-theoretic threshold for exact label recovery, in terms of a Chernoff-Hellinger divergence criterion. Impossibility of recovery below the threshold is proven by a unified analysis using a Cramér lower bound. Achievability above the threshold is proven via an efficient two-phase algorithm, where the first phase computes an almost-exact labeling through a local propagation scheme, while the second phase refines the labels. The information-theoretic threshold is dictated by the performance of the so-called genie estimator, which decodes the label of a single vertex given all the other labels. This shows that our proposed models exhibit the local-to-global amplification phenomenon.

</details>


### [402] [Ollivier-Ricci curvature in cycle overlap mode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03317)
*Zexian Zhou,Bo Jiao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于最优传输原理的Ollivier-Ricci曲率计算方法CCOM，通过3,4,5-环来最小化距离，并设计了贪心剪枝算法进行近似计算，在保持低时间消耗的同时显著提高了大规模无标度网络上曲率计算的准确性，并在社区检测任务中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Ollivier-Ricci曲率计算复杂度高或误差大，限制了其在大规模无标度图上的应用，因此需要一种高效且准确的曲率计算方法。

Method: 提出最优传输原理，利用包含边(x,y)的3,4,5-环最小化距离；设计了CCOM（Cycle Overlap Mode）曲率计算方法，并采用贪心与剪枝算法来近似该最优传输原理。

Result: 理论分析和实验验证均表明，CCOM在真实网络上显著提高了曲率计算精度，同时保持了低时间消耗；在社区检测任务中，CCOM相比基线近似方法在大型无标度图上表现更优。

Conclusion: CCOM方法能够高效准确地计算大规模无标度图的Ollivier-Ricci曲率，并有效应用于社区检测等下游任务。

Abstract: Ollivier-Ricci curvature of an edge (x,y) is defined by comparing the distance taken to transport from neighbors of x to neighbors of y. It is a structural measure that has been studied in many fields such as community detection and deep neural networks. However, high computational complexity or error limits its application in large scale-free graphs. This paper proposes an optimal transport principle to minimize the distance by 3,4,5-cycles that include the edge (x,y), and designs a curvature calculation approach named Curvature in Cycle Overlap Mode (CCOM). In this approach, a greedy and pruning algorithm is proposed to approximate the optimal transport principle. We theoretically and experimentally verified that our approach CCOM can significantly improve the accuracy of the curvature on real-world networks with low time consumption. In addition, we compared CCOM with baseline approximation approaches in community detection tasks using the same curvature-based framework, and experimentally confirmed the effectiveness of CCOM on large scale-free graphs.

</details>


### [403] [MIDSim: Simulating Multi-Channel Information Diffusion in Social Media with LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13140)
*Lexi Liu,Qi Cao,Yuanhao Liu,Huawei Shen,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于LLM的多智能体系统，通过模拟社交链接和算法推荐双通道信息扩散，在微博、小红书、推特三个真实数据集上优于现有基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息扩散模型（流行病、级联、点过程）主要关注社交链接传播，忽略了平台算法（如推荐系统）带来的其他扩散通道，且未能捕捉用户行为复杂性。

Method: 构建LLM驱动的多智能体系统，用大语言模型实例化个性化用户智能体，扩散过程联合建模社交曝光流和算法曝光流；构建了包含扩散记录、用户画像、历史帖文和社交关系的三个真实数据集。

Result: 在真实扩散事件上，该方法在宏观扩散现象模拟和多样化评论内容生成方面显著优于基线模型。

Conclusion: 结合LLM与多通道扩散建模能更真实地模拟社交媒体信息扩散过程，弥补了传统模型忽略算法推荐通道的不足。

Abstract: Information diffusion in social media shapes public opinion and collective behavior, making its modeling and simulation an important research problem. Existing studies have investigated information diffusion through epidemic-based, cascade-based, and point process models. However, they predominantly focus on diffusion through social links, overlooking other diffusion channels enabled by platform algorithms (e.g., recommender systems) and failing to capture user behavioral complexity. To address these limitations, we propose an LLM-powered multi-agent system for simulating multi-channel information diffusion, where large language models instantiate personalized user agents and the diffusion process jointly models social and algorithmic exposure streams. We further construct three real-world diffusion dataset spanning Sina Weibo, RedNote, and Twitter, containing diffusion records, user profiles, historical posts, and social relationships. Experimental results on real diffusion events show that our proposed framework realistically simulate macro diffusion phenomenon and generate diverse comment content, significantly outperforming baselines.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [404] [Bayesian Optimization for Learning Nonlinear MPC in Autonomous Agent Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14763)
*Lorenzo Ortolani,Gabriel Voss,Gabriele Beltrami,Francesco Dorati,Tommaso Felice Banfi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需地图的实时自主导航框架，将滚动时域规划与非线性MPC相结合，并通过离线贝叶斯优化和TPE进行参数调优，在Unitree Go2四足机器人上实现了高达90%的导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决动态未知环境中移动机器人实时自主导航的挑战，特别是传统方法对参数敏感且依赖地图的问题。

Method: 1) 基于LiDAR的高斯占据表示构建；2) A*搜索生成无碰撞轨迹；3) CasADi/IPOPT非线性MPC跟踪轨迹，含sigmoid障碍物屏障函数；4) TPE离线贝叶斯优化调参；5) 高斯过程替代模型分析参数敏感性。

Result: 仿真参数可零调优迁移至硬件；部署时导航成功率高达90.0%；仿真环境中评估指标平均提升38.9%。

Conclusion: 提出的地图无关、机器人无关的导航框架在四足机器人上验证了从仿真到硬件的有效迁移，显著提升了导航性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Real-time autonomous navigation in dynamic, unknown environments remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robotics. We propose a map-free framework that tightly integrates reactive rolling-horizon planning with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC). At each control cycle, a LiDAR-based Gaussian occupancy representation is constructed and used to generate collision-free trajectories via A* search, which are then tracked by a CasADi/IPOPT MPC formulation incorporating a smooth sigmoid obstacle barrier. To improve robustness to parameter sensitivity, we adopt an offline Bayesian optimization scheme based on Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), which identifies near-optimal controller parameters with respect to a composite navigation objective. In addition, a Gaussian Process surrogate is used to analyze parameter sensitivity and provide insight into the optimization landscape.
  The proposed framework is robot-agnostic and is evaluated on the Unitree Go2 quadruped in simulation using Gazebo, followed by deployment on the physical robot. Experimental results show that parameters tuned in simulation transfer effectively to hardware, maintaining comparable performance without additional tuning. The full system achieves up to a 90.0\% navigation success rate when deployed, along with a 38.9\% average improvement in the evaluation metrics across simulated environments.

</details>


### [405] [Synthetic-to-Real Pipeline for Safe Landing Zone Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14767)
*Shrikant Banerjee,Reza Faieghi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套面向无人机自主着陆的感知与数据生成管线，通过程序化合成数据引擎生成逼真城市环境并自动语义标注，基于Transformer的OneFormer架构在纯合成数据上微调，结合欧氏距离变换与动态推理实现安全着陆区域检测，在UAVid数据集和真实无人机视频上验证了有效性，消除了人工标注需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机向高自主性演进时，需要在非合作、非结构化环境中实现无辅助回收，但缺乏带标注的航拍数据集严重制约了安全自主着陆能力的发展。

Method: 1) 程序化合成数据引擎：通过域随机化生成逼真城市环境并自动生成语义标注；2) 基于Transformer的OneFormer架构：利用多头自注意力机制进行全局上下文建模，仅在合成数据上微调；3) 确定性着陆模块：采用欧氏距离变换(EDT)和动态推理逻辑，在障碍物周围保持严格安全缓冲区的前提下识别最大内接安全着陆区域。

Result: 在UAVid数据集上的定量评估展示了鲁棒的语义分割性能；在真实无人机视频上的定性验证确认了系统在未见环境中识别无碰撞着陆点的能力。

Conclusion: 高保真程序化仿真能够消除人工标注需求，同时为无人机自主回收提供鲁棒且可在边缘部署的情境感知能力。

Abstract: As Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) transition toward higher levels of autonomy, the ability to perform unassisted recovery in non-cooperative, unstructured environments becomes critical. Achieving safe autonomous landing requires high-fidelity semantic resolution to distinguish navigable terrain from hazardous obstacles, yet development is often hindered by the scarcity of annotated aerial datasets. This work proposes a comprehensive perception and data generation pipeline designed to bridge the sim-to-real gap for autonomous landing tasks. We introduce a procedural synthetic data engine that generates photorealistic urban environments with automated semantic annotations through domain randomization. A Transformer-based OneFormer architecture is fine-tuned exclusively on this synthetic data, leveraging multi-head self-attention mechanisms for global context resolution. To ensure operational safety, a deterministic landing module utilizes a Euclidean Distance Transform (EDT) and dynamic inference logic to identify the largest inscribed safe landing zones while maintaining strict clearance buffers around obstacles. Quantitative benchmarking against the UAVid dataset demonstrates robust semantic segmentation performance, while qualitative validation on real-world UAV footage confirms the system's ability to identify collision-free landing sites in unseen environments. Our results highlight the potential of high-fidelity procedural simulation to eliminate the need for manual annotation while providing robust, edge-deployable situational awareness for autonomous UAV recovery.

</details>


### [406] [Deep Learning-Based Lunar Crater Terrain Relative Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14776)
*Batu Candan,Simone Servadio*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合深度学习陨石坑检测器和扩展卡尔曼滤波的地形相对导航（TRN）算法，用于月球着陆器的精确位姿估计，即使在初始偏差高达5公里时也能将导航误差降低到几百米。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来月球着陆任务需要精确的位置估计，尤其是在地形特征稀疏的危险环境中，传统的导航方法难以满足要求。

Method: 1) 使用专为NASA陨石坑检测挑战设计的深度学习陨石坑检测器分析单目图像中的陨石坑特征；2) 通过匈牙利分配方法和基于共识的离群点去除方法将检测到的陨石坑与全球数据库进行匹配；3) 将测量结果输入扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），在月球中心月球固定（LCLF）参考系中进行航天器位姿估计，并加入高度辅助信息约束径向漂移。

Result: 仿真结果表明，即使航天器初始位置偏差高达5公里，TRN算法也能恢复，将导航误差降低到几百米。

Conclusion: 保持陨石坑特征对应关系的关键在于使图像分辨率和场景尺度与检测器训练集分布相匹配。

Abstract: Accurate position estimation is crucial for the successful implementation of future lunar landings using autonomous vehicles, especially in dangerous environments with sparse terrain features. In this paper, we propose a terrain relative navigation (TRN) algorithm combining our deep-learning crater detector, which was designed specifically for the NASA Crater Detection Challenge problem, and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). Our detector analyzes crater features from the monocular images acquired from orbit, and their matches with craters from a global database are identified via a Hungarian assignment approach followed by the consensus-based outliers removal method. The estimated measurements are then used to refine an EKF, where spacecraft pose estimation in the Lunar-Centered Lunar-Fixed (LCLF) frame of reference, augmented with altitude aiding information, constrains radial drift. The simulation results indicate that even if the spacecraft is off from its actual location up to 5 km, TRN could recover from this situation, achieving navigation error reduction to a few hundred meters. It should be noted that in order to maintain crater feature correspondences, it is important to match the image resolution and the scales within the scene to the detector training set distribution.

</details>


### [407] [Computing Smooth Geodesics under Two-Sided Curvature Bounds with Applications to Robotics and Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14794)
*Da Chen,Zhenjiang Li,Jean-Marie Mirebeau,Xuecheng Tai,Jinglin Zhang,Wei Zhang,Laurent D. Cohen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程框架的曲率有界测地线模型，能够对平面曲线的曲率施加任意上下界约束，从而生成光滑且曲率受限的最小路径；该模型通过离散化方案实现高效数值求解，并在机器人路径规划和图像曲线结构跟踪任务中验证了其鲁棒性和有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面曲线的曲率是计算二阶最小路径的关键正则化项，与光滑性、刚性和弹性等几何性质密切相关。然而，现有方法难以对曲率施加任意的上下界约束，因此需要一种能够提供强几何控制、同时保证路径光滑且曲率受限的新模型。
